name: Assist Patient with a Bedpan
summary:
Assist Patient with a Bedpan is an immersive VR training experience designed for healthcare students and professionals to develop essential patient care skills with confidence and sensitivity.

This simulation guides users through the complete process of assisting a patient with a bedpan, including preparation, proper positioning, hygiene practices, and effective communication. Emphasis is placed on maintaining patient dignity, comfort, and safety throughout the procedure.
